sculpt_cart_hand.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_cart_hand.notes: The carter's handcart (gameplay/errands-props.js makeCart): plank bed, side boards on stakes, tail board, shafts with a cross grip and a prop leg, two spoked wheels with iron tyres and turned hubs, ribbed pumpkins on straw. Faces +Z, origin on the ground between the wheels; bed 0.62 m, wheels r 0.43 m. LOD tris 8387 / 6379 / 2125. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
